scripts.build: npm run mini && npm run finalizer
scripts.mini: cd minified && cat ../src/core.js ../src/main.js > combined.js && terser -o main.js -c passes=2 -m toplevel -- combined.js && rm combined.js && cd .. && cp index.html ./minified/index.html && css-minify -f ./src/style.css -o ./minified/
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run zip
